lesson.title: The move, as a diagram
lesson.skill: Read a diagram of an equation, and see the same thing you would see written out.
lesson.missionLink: You said the algebra goes in circles. A diagram is the part of the loop you can see.

primarySource.why: It draws the same two steps as arrows.
